# Signage content

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_content.py from content/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand; edit the YAML and re-run the script. -->

This is the text that goes on the screens, rendered in a readable form from the YAML files under `content/`. The YAML is the source of truth and is what `manage.py loadcontent` imports. Layout names refer to `docs/design.md`, the phase names to `content/event.yaml`.

## How the rotation works

- Every slide exists in Hungarian and English. In `alternate` mode the player shows the Hungarian pass, then the English pass, each for `duration_seconds`. In `stacked` mode both languages share one pass, Hungarian large and English beneath.
- A slide is in rotation only while the event is in one of its `phases`. The organizer sets the phase in the admin, or lets the clock pick it.
- Inside one cycle slides are ordered by `priority` (high first), then by the order in this file. Live slides re-render on every bundle refresh.
- Strings in `{braces}` are placeholders filled from the Event model at render time.

## Announcement templates

Organizers activate these from the admin, filling the `{placeholders}`. `takeover` announcements replace the rotation while active; the others render as a bar at the bottom of the safe area.

| Key | Level | Takeover | Magyar | English |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `match_call` | urgent | yes | CS2: {team_a} vs {team_b} {minutes} perc múlva kezdődik. Gyertek a gépetekhez! | CS2: {team_a} vs {team_b} starts in {minutes} minutes. Get to your PCs! |
| `match_live` | info | no | CS2 most: {team_a} vs {team_b}. Nézd a kivetítőn vagy a streams.ctrl-alt-gg.hu oldalon. | CS2 now: {team_a} vs {team_b}. Watch on the projector or at streams.ctrl-alt-gg.hu. |
| `next_game` | info | no | Következik: {game} {time}-kor. A szervert a servers.ctrl-alt-gg.hu oldalon találod. | Next up: {game} at {time}. Find the server at servers.ctrl-alt-gg.hu. |
| `break` | info | no | Szünet {until}-ig. Egyél, igyál, nyújtózz. | Break until {until}. Eat, drink, stretch. |
| `pizza` | info | no | Közös pizzarendelés {deadline}-ig a #general csatornán. | Group pizza order closes at {deadline} in #general. |
| `awards` | warning | yes | CS2-díjátadó {time}-kor a közös gyülekezőnél. Kb. 15 perc. | CS2 awards at {time} at the gathering area. About 15 minutes. |
| `power` | warning | no | Áramgond a(z) {area} környékén. Húzd ki, ami nem kell. Dolgozunk rajta. | Power issue near {area}. Unplug what you do not need. We are on it. |
| `network` | warning | no | Hálózati karbantartás {from}-{to}. Rövid kiesés várható. | Network maintenance {from}-{to}. Expect a short outage. |
| `known_issue` | warning | no | Ismert hiba: {issue}. Megoldás: {workaround}. | Known issue: {issue}. Workaround: {workaround}. |
| `lost_found` | info | no | Talált tárgy a szervezői asztalnál: {item}. | Found at the organizer desk: {item}. |
| `quiet` | info | no | Halkabban: éjfél után vedd vissza a hangerőt és a kiabálást. | Keep it down: lower the volume and the shouting after midnight. |
| `last_call` | warning | no | Utolsó kör: {time}-kor zárunk. Kezdj el pakolni. | Last call: we close at {time}. Start packing. |
| `evacuate` | urgent | yes | Hagyd el az épületet a legközelebbi kijáraton. A géped marad. Gyülekező: {assembly_point}. | Leave the building through the nearest exit. Leave your PC. Assembly point: {assembly_point}. |
